outfit_contract: Every itinerary day needs photo_advice.outfit_advice: {women, men, practical_note}, all non-empty strings. Give two practical outfits suited to season, walking and planned places; shared adjustments cover layers/rain/venue dress rules without inventing a forecast. Render in main itinerary and Trip Mode. See research-data-shapes.md.
souvenir_media: For products use kind=souvenir (type/place_kind aliases accepted), product_name or exact local display_name, official_url, optional verified brand_name. Product helper reads body/lazy/srcset/JSON-LD images and follows at most two exact same-site links; never use nearby street images. Search the exact official product first, then one reputable exact-product retailer/tourism source if needed; record actual URLs, outcomes and fallback reason in .research-state/candidate-ledger.json. Only after bounded search fails or explicit access restrictions block it, keep images: [] and buying advice; never skip lookup merely because images are optional. Explicit user text-only requests are exempt. Honor product_media_status/next_action; standard brand fallback remains explicitly official_brand_asset, never product photography.
candidate_readback: research_image_candidates.py prints validated structured candidate URLs/source pages/coordinates to stdout. Use them directly; no extra read call. For recovery use inspect_research_json.py with the exact printed source_file path as one quoted argument; do not invent filenames or ad hoc JSON parsers.
page_probe: Use scripts/probe_official_page.py URL --output research/drafts/page.json --timeout 10 for official title/description/og:image metadata. Standard library only; never assume requests/bs4 or compose complex Python one-liners through PowerShell. Read status; candidates are not identity or visual verification.
map_delivery: New builds require exactly one reviewed offline overview per day with all scheduled stops; do not automatically add local views; follow references/screenshot-map-workflow.md. First attempt original street-map capture. Only after evidenced failure use references/offline-map-fallback.md; no online-map fallback. Route lists alone are not offline maps.
tip_priority: Each travel note requires explicit priority 必须/建议/随缘 based on actual constraints, not title matching or quotas.

execution_rule: Work only within the current bounded batch. For named venues, perform cheap identity, coordinate and image URL/MIME/dimension feasibility before freezing the place. Do not download final assets yet. Write and validate this pack before expanding scope. Generated requirements and named JSON-pointer errors are sufficient; do not read validator source unless an error remains unexplained.

delegation_contract.scope: Write only target_file for this task; do not edit other packs, the compiled profile, runtime files or final HTML.
delegation_contract.context: Use travel-brief.json, this task JSON, the assigned frozen IDs/area boundary and only directly relevant references. Do not load the full conversation or unrelated packs.
delegation_contract.handoff: Validate target_file immediately, then report its path and only unresolved source incidents or proposed frozen-ID replacements.

shape_reference: Read references/research-data-shapes.md before authoring. Use validate_research_pack.py --scaffold PACK for exact fields. Language: local term/meaning/reading (Japanese reading required); English phrases use sentence/meaning. Place type is the renderer family, not temple/shrine/nightlife. Stop order must include dwell and transfer time.
record_writing: Write the complete canonical pack atomically to target_file and validate it once. Use the pack scaffold for unfamiliar shapes. Record-level tools are recovery aids only.
work_units: Use references/production-flow.md. Research a complete pack batch with concurrent independent lookups; reuse facts across modules.
failure_counter: After repeated failure of the same operation, inspect its actual error and change the method. Preserve valid packs and repair only the affected data.
runner_commands: Use the verified Python interpreter or the generated workbench travel.ps1 for supported actions. Its absolute path binds the workbench. Whole-pack authoring needs no timer or assembly commands.
completion_rule: Save researched JSON to target_file and validate required_fields. Images need an identity-bearing source page and valid acquisition metadata; use an existing decoded local file or a verified direct image URL. Small dimensions alone are advisory. Do not fabricate download or visual evidence.

brief_rule: Use the current approved brief and itinerary-outline.md; preserve its travelers, interests, constraints and exclusions in research/framing.json.trip and selection. These inputs are already supplied; do not ask the questionnaire again. The linked brief owns any additional user fields.
writing_rules: Cover title/title_lines are short editorial phrases and never repeat city, dates, duration or traveler count.
Cover identity must name the depicted venue and consulted source; image URL alone is insufficient. For this build same-place cover photos, declare derived_from and identical provenance URLs.

Prepare dining_plan from the approved itinerary meals: date, meal, place_id for named venues, title, category, budget, note; genuinely unassigned meals use flexible=true and a valid itinerary date. Scheduled places require coordinate_source with url/note/precision; image declarations require an observed source_identity_note. Reuse researched facts; do not add restaurants merely to fill this overview. An empty array is appropriate only when no meals are specified.

Prepare time_anchors with at most four reliable fixed appointments, pickups or departure deadlines: time, title, note, href. If none are confirmed, use an empty array; ordinary planned sightseeing times are not fixed anchors.
